response:
The user is asking whether there is an association between Panton-Valentine leucocidin (PVL) and the pathogenesis of Staphylococcus aureus bacteraemia in the UK. According to the retrieved matches, we found that 1.6% of S. aureus (all MSSA) from bacteraemic patients were PVL-positive.

This low incidence suggests that PVL-positive S. aureus are of no particular significance as causative agents of S. aureus bacteraemia in the UK.
